versions.name: Camp Avantura BSA
versions.address: Autokamp Veli Joze, Borozija 3C, 52475 Savudrija, Croatia

features.note: Seaside property on the Adriatic; aquatics classes are held in the sea.
The ACE Program, an Accelerated Camper Experience track for first-year campers.

versions.summary: Transatlantic Council seaside Scouts BSA resident camp in Savudrija, offering the ACE first-year program, merit badges in aquatics, outdoor skills, handicrafts, and science, plus IOLS adult training.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/802-CampAvantura2026); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
